entries.surface: Q1 paper vs printed code pp86-94
entries.finding: paper describes IGA/Pareto search; printed multi_objective_route_planning() calls Dijkstra and returns one path; no genetic/Pareto primitive appears
problem is written as max interest/min repeat, but fitness collapses it to w1*Ffun-w2*Frep-penalty; preservation of a Pareto set needs an additional nondominated mechanism
printed code contains fixed score/element/openness dictionaries matching the reported ranking, overriding preceding computed values
fractal dimension, NNI, openness sequences and contag use random/synthetic generators inside the nominal real-data pipeline
paper says AHP-entropy; code says AHP-CRITIC and actually uses fixed weights without deriving AHP/entropy/CRITIC weights
reported Kappa=0.833 while evaluation criterion is written Kappa>0.833; displayed value does not satisfy the strict inequality
MRE/Kappa/coherence/ARI/CV-MSE values and Table13 uncertainty bars have no visible computation path in printed Q2 code
prose states Pearson p=0.012 and Spearman p=0.018; Table17 states Pearson p=0.018 and Spearman p=0.012

paper claims geometry/image/text + MKL/contrastive + PH/HMM; printed code has empty/stub features, omitted training, untrained EmbeddingNet, and topology/behavior both derived from the same embedding distances
with garden as the independent unit, pair-level random split can share the same garden across folds; visible paper does not establish garden-level grouping before pair creation
r2=max(0.75,min(0.95,1-mse/var)) forces any computed R2 into [0.75,0.95]
printed code returns avg_mse=30.0, avg_mae=4.5, avg_r2=0.78 as constants, exactly matching Table19 5-fold metrics
bright unit diagonal of a self-similarity matrix is an identity property and cannot serve as proof of model effectiveness/generalization

global_gates: paper method label must map to printed/executable primitives
synthetic/random placeholders must be provenance-tagged and excluded from real-result claims
hard-coded output must never override computed model output in evidence path
reported validation metric must be computed, not clipped/floored/capped or returned as a constant
pairwise examples must be grouped by underlying entity for unseen-entity generalization
multimodal component names require distinct modality-specific data/primitives
self-similarity diagonal is not validation evidence
